description: Does a test-authoring skill produce a suite that catches defects a capable model misses on its own? Four unguided cases over examples/fixtures/ledger-service, a stdlib-only ledger whose six seeded defects sit behind a conversion, a sequence or a silent fallback. No case names the slice holding a defect: an earlier draft did, the control passed it at 0.8669, and naming the slice turned out to hand over the defect's location. Every case is scored on the catch rate across all six defects, so deciding what is worth pinning is the work. Activation is deliberately not an assertion: the composite is quality only, so invoking a skill cannot move the headline. Routing is reported separately from the traces.
